messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@slackbot.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Free credits not showing after signup (coupon applied)

Hi Ben —

We just completed the self-serve signup for Slackbot.ai engineers and the coupon we entered (REDFREE2027) didn’t apply. The signup flow reported the coupon accepted, but the dashboard balance shows 0 free credits and the ‘trial active’ badge never appeared. We hit this during onboarding with a small pilot (5 engineers) and it’s blocking our demo tomorrow.

Attached a quick screenshot of the account dashboard and the browser console where the flow confirmed coupon acceptance. Account email: trial+slackbot@slackbot.ai. Can you help? We’d rather not wait for manual support if this is a self-serve flow.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of Platform
Slackbot.ai

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the heads up and the screenshot, really helpful. I’m looping in Dev from Core Ops to take a look at the coupon webhook and the account state.

Quick asks so we can triage fast:
- Can you confirm the exact account id or the email you used (you mentioned trial+slackbot@slackbot.ai — if there’s a different org id that helps)
- Approx time of signup (including timezone)
- If possible, paste the full coupon code from the confirmation page (you listed REDFREE2027 which matches our promo)

If this looks like a transient self-serve failure we’ll either push a manual grant immediately or give you steps to refresh the wallet. If it’s a webhook/processor issue we’ll escalate internally and share ETA.

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@slackbot.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Free credits not showing after signup (coupon applied)

Thanks for the ping, Ben — I dug into the coupon service logs and found a failed webhook delivery for account trial+slackbot@slackbot.ai at 2027-06-21T09:12:08Z. The downstream coupon processor returned a 409 (idempotency conflict) right after our record created a temporary reference; our retry logic treated that as a non-success and did not mark the wallet grant complete.

Short summary and immediate remediation plan:
- Root cause: idempotency mismatch between our signup service and coupon processor; the processor accepted the coupon but returned 409 on duplicate id during retry, and our handler didn’t reconcile final state.
- Impact: self-serve coupon flows for a small subset of concurrent signups may not show the grant despite it being recorded in the processor.
- Next steps: I can issue a manual wallet grant for the account now (10k tokens equivalent) and patch the handler to re-check processor state on 409 before marking failure. I’ve opened SUP-3421 to track the fix.

Samira — if you’re OK I’ll run the manual grant now and send a receipt. Also cc’ing Marissa for approval on doing a manual exception (billing write) and whether we should offer a short trial extension as a goodwill gesture.

Logs attached: coupon_webhook_20270621.log (text)

— Dev
